answer: One defense is a novelty-bonded contribution trellis. To open a seat, an operator grafts one verified, non-duplicative increment onto a shared public grove - a corrected dataset row, a repaired test - and bonds against redundancy. A similarity check compares it with everything already on the trellis, so near-copies are rejected and peers can slash the bond. Cloned wallets submitting the same artifact collapse into one seat. The graft must also survive a full voyage of the epoch cycle, or it lapses. Attack cost is N distinct pieces of useful work, plus N bonds, plus the labor of tending them.
